description: This file is a shell script that performs tests and setup for the 'gitweb' project. It includes functions for snapshot validation, project setup with git, configuration modifications, and various test cases for the standalone 'gitweb' script behavior, including project listing, snapshot creation, and security checks.

methods.name: check_snapshot
methods.description: Validates a snapshot output by checking the filename and tarfile contents based on given parameters.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes the 'gitweb' script with specified parameters and captures output for testing.
